name: Speed of light in vacuum
definition: The invariant speed at which light propagates in vacuum.

name: Signed boost velocity divided by c
definition: The signed relative velocity of the inertial frames divided by the vacuum light speed.

name: Lorentz factor
definition: The factor that scales time and length comparisons in a boost, \(\gamma=(1-eta^2)^{-1/2}\).

name: Lorentz transformation matrix
definition: A matrix relating two inertial coordinate systems while preserving the Minkowski metric.

name: Spacetime interval squared
search_terms: delta s squared ds^2 invariant separation Δs²
definition: The Minkowski metric applied twice to the separation vector between two events.

name: Minkowski metric
search_terms: eta mu nu flat metric signature η_μν eta_munu
definition: The bilinear form that gives the spacetime interval in flat spacetime. In the atlas’s inertial coordinates its matrix is \(\mathrm{diag}(1,-1,-1,-1)\).

name: Proper time
definition: Time elapsed on a clock following a specified timelike path.

name: Position four-vector
search_terms: x mu ct spacetime coordinates x^μ x^mu
definition: The four inertial coordinates of an event relative to a chosen origin.

name: Four-velocity
search_terms: U mu four velocity U^μ U^mu

name: Four-momentum
search_terms: p mu four momentum energy momentum p^μ p^mu

name: Electromagnetic four-potential
search_terms: A mu A^mu four potential A_μ A_mu

name: Electromagnetic field tensor
search_terms: F mu nu field strength F_μν F_munu

name: Electric four-current
search_terms: j mu four current source j^μ j^mu
definition: The spacetime vector combining charge density and electric current density, \(j^\mu=(c\rho,\mathbf j)\).

name: D’Alembertian
definition: The flat-spacetime wave operator, \(\Box=c^{-2}\partial_t^2-\nabla^2\), in the atlas’s metric convention.

name: Stress–energy tensor
search_terms: T mu nu stress energy momentum tensor T^μν T^munu

name: Angular frequency
definition: The rate at which the phase of a wave changes with time at a fixed position, measured in radians per second.

name: Wave vector
definition: The vector describing how the wave phase changes with position. For a plane wave it points along the direction of propagation and has magnitude \(2\pi/\lambda\), where \(\lambda\) is the wavelength.

name: Scalar wave field
definition: A single scalar value at each spacetime point that varies according to the wave equation.

name: Coordinate time
definition: Time assigned to events by the synchronised clocks of a chosen frame.

name: Time coordinate in length units
definition: The time component of a spacetime position, \(x^0=ct\), expressed in units of length.

name: Mostly-minus metric signature
definition: The sign convention in which the time term of the Minkowski interval is positive and the three spatial terms are negative.

name: Coordinate derivative
definition: The partial derivative with respect to the spacetime coordinate \(x^\mu\), holding the other coordinates fixed.

name: Raised coordinate derivative
definition: The coordinate derivative with its index raised by the inverse metric, \(\partial^\mu=\eta^{\mu\nu}\partial_\nu\).

name: Spatial Laplacian
definition: The sum of the second spatial derivatives along the three Cartesian coordinate axes.

name: Electromagnetic four-potential (raised index)
definition: The contravariant electromagnetic potential, with SI components \(A^\mu=(\phi/c,\mathbf A)\).

name: Electromagnetic field tensor (raised indices)
definition: The electromagnetic field tensor with both indices raised by the inverse Minkowski metric. It describes the electric and magnetic fields together.

name: Vacuum permeability
definition: The SI constant relating electric four-current to the divergence of the field tensor, \(\partial_\mu F^{\mu\nu}=\mu_0j^\nu\).

name: Coordinate velocity
definition: The rate of change of spatial position with respect to the time of a chosen frame.

name: Rest length
definition: The distance between the endpoints measured simultaneously in the object's rest frame.

name: Length in the measuring frame
definition: The distance between the endpoints measured at the same coordinate time in the chosen frame.

name: Event separation four-vector
definition: The coordinate difference between two events in a given inertial frame.

name: Total particle energy
definition: The energy associated with the time component of four-momentum in the chosen frame.

name: Spatial momentum
definition: The spatial part of four-momentum in the chosen frame.

name: Kinetic energy
definition: The difference between a particle's total energy and its rest energy.

name: Three-force
definition: The rate of change of spatial momentum with respect to coordinate time.

name: Generalised coordinate
definition: One of the independent variables specifying the configuration of a mechanical system.

name: Generalised velocity
definition: The coordinate-time derivative of a generalised coordinate.

name: Potential energy
definition: The energy assigned to a configuration by a conservative interaction.

name: Field action
definition: The spacetime integral of the Lagrangian density for a specified field history.

name: Vector field
definition: A field assigning a vector to each event.

name: Field component
definition: One of the field variables varied independently in the action.

name: Field derivative coefficient
definition: The derivative of the Lagrangian density with respect to the spacetime derivative of one field component.

name: Scalar-field potential energy density
definition: The contribution to the scalar field's energy density that depends only on its local value.
